# pve_ceph_pool (Data Source)

Reads a single Ceph pool and its settings from `GET /nodes/{node}/ceph/pool`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright IBM Corp. 2021, 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

data "pve_ceph_pool" "rbd" {
  node = "pve1"
  name = "rbd"
}

output "rbd_pool_id" {
  value = data.pve_ceph_pool.rbd.pool_id
}

output "rbd_pg_num" {
  value = data.pve_ceph_pool.rbd.pg_num
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the pool (`pool_name` in the listing).
- `node` (String) Management node the listing request is issued against.

### Read-Only

- `application_metadata` (String) Raw JSON object of application tags attached to the pool (mapping of application name to its metadata); empty when unset.
- `autoscale_status` (String) Raw JSON pg_autoscaler status object for this pool; the shape varies between Ceph releases.
- `bytes_used` (Number) Bytes currently used in the pool; absent when no usage statistics are reported.
- `crush_rule_id` (Number) Numeric id of the CRUSH rule used by this pool.
- `crush_rule_name` (String) Human-readable name of the CRUSH rule used by this pool.
- `id` (String) Identifier in the form `<node>:<name>`.
- `min_size` (Number) Minimum number of replicas required to accept writes.
- `percent_used` (Number) Percentage of pool capacity currently used; absent when no usage statistics are reported.
- `pg_autoscale_mode` (String) Placement-group autoscaler mode: `on`, `warn`, or `off`.
- `pg_num` (Number) Current placement-group count.
- `pg_num_final` (Number) Optimal placement-group count computed by the pg_autoscaler.
- `pg_num_min` (Number) Minimum placement-group count the pg_autoscaler may choose.
- `pool_id` (Number) Numeric pool id assigned by Ceph.
- `pool_type` (String) Pool type: `replicated` for n-way replication, `erasure` for an erasure-coded pool, or `unknown`.
- `size` (Number) Replication factor (target number of object replicas).
- `target_size` (Number) Operator-supplied target size in bytes hinting the pg_autoscaler.
- `target_size_ratio` (Number) Operator-supplied target ratio of total pool capacity hinting the pg_autoscaler.
